newsitem.title: FRANCE: Canal Plus, 2MI form multimedia investment fund.
newsitem.headline: Canal Plus, 2MI form multimedia investment fund.

text.p: Canal Plus has agreed to participate in Multimedia Investissements, the first multimedia investment fund created by investment group 2MI, said 2MI in a statement on Monday.
It gave no further details of its accord with Canal Plus.
The fund will provide 33 percent of the finance needed by selected European projects for multimedia, the statement said.
2MI said that at the end of January the European Commission gave it a brief to find and encourage promising multimedia initiatives in Europe.
It aims ultimately to have 20 partners from across the European Union, among media, production and broadcasting companies and institutional investors, it said.
It is in the process of finalising six other investment funds with Britain's BBC Worldwide, Germany's Bertelsmann , France's Havas, Sweden's Kinnevik , Spain's Prisa and Dutch Philips, it said.
